metadata.quote: As of December 31, 2025, the SABIC Board comprises the following directors
SABIC has a one-tier Board consisting of nine directors

The Board was reformed through GA voting on April 9, 2025, for a new three-year term ending on April 9, 2028.
During the year ended December 31, 2025, the Board met seven times.

disclosures.title: Sale of the ALBA stake to Ma'aden approved by the Ordinary General Assembly
disclosures.body_text: SABIC Industrial Investments Co. sold its 20.62% stake in ALBA (292,804,000 shares) to the Saudi Arabian Mining Company (Ma'aden) for BHD 363,076,960 (about SAR 3.61 billion); the Board Vice Chairman has an indirect interest as a member of the Ma'aden Board. Approved by the Ordinary General Assembly on April 9, 2025.

metadata.quote: sold its stake in ALBA Co., amounting to 292,804,000 common shares representing 20.62% of the total shareholding of ALBA, to the Saudi Arabian Mining Company (Ma’aden)

disclosures.title: Board reconstituted for a new three-year term from April 10, 2025
disclosures.body_text: The General Assembly of April 9, 2025 elected the Board for a new three-year term (April 10, 2025 to April 9, 2028). Dr. Ramesh Ramachandran, Mohammed Al-Subaie and Lucrèce De Ridder joined; Mohammed Al-Nahas, Nader Al-Wehibi and Calum MacLean left on April 9, 2025.

metadata.quote: On April 10, 2025, the Board commenced a new three-year term with a refreshed formation with three new directors, including a woman.

disclosures.title: Executive Vice President, Strategy & Transformation served until April 1, 2025
disclosures.body_text: Anas Kentab served as Executive Vice President, Strategy & Transformation until April 1, 2025.
